title: Coefficient 7/2, exponent 1 for the explicit BK disperser family via Mishra-Santhanam gate elimination

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total input-prefix family F defined in proof.md: F_0=0; for N>=1 let B be the least integer with B^5>32*N^3 and k the least prime >=B; if k>=N output 0; else read the first k bits as the lower coefficients of a monic degree-k polynomial Q over F_2, output 0 unless Q is irreducible (prime-degree test of proof.md Section 2); put m=N-k, r=ceil(m/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)); zero-pad the last m bits into r blocks u_i in K=F_2[Z]/(Q), set y_i=u_i^(2^(r+2-i)-1), and output Tr_K(E_t(y_1,...,y_r)), the trace of the t-th elementary symmetric polynomial. One fixed evaluator defines every length.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"2","numerator":"7"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"2","numerator":"7"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this one total uniform polynomial-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(F_N)>=(7/2)*N-120*N^(4/5) for every integer N>=2^22, hence liminf C_B2(F_N)/N>=7/2 at actual input length N in the full Li-Yang B2 model.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
